reports.name: Foot rot 4B (71-73 cM)
reports.note: Fusarium foot and root rot (F. graminearum) seedling assay, 190 northern European winter wheat genotypes, 20K SNP array (7,360 SNPs), GWAS on disease score in treatment Fg (P <= 0.00014). Minor alleles TT, GG and CC reduce disease score (P < 0.05). The candidate-gene paragraph puts BS00096604_51 on 4D; the association results put all three on 4B. Placed in silico (RefSeq v1.0): BS00096604_51 497.229 Mb (Sun et al. 2020 PBJ (90K)); RFL_Contig2459_2314 497.554 Mb (Sun et al. 2020 PBJ (90K)); Ku_c33858_325 499.849 Mb (Sun et al. 2020 PBJ (90K)). Read from the journal PDF, Nov 2026 (ad57.py).
